description: Halliburton Company is one of the world's largest providers of products and services to the energy industry. Its predecessor was established in 1919 and incorporated under the laws of the State of Delaware in 1924, and what started with a single product from a single location is now a global enterprise whose value proposition is to collaborate and engineer solutions to maximize asset value for its customers. It strives to achieve strong cash flows and returns for its shareholders by delivering technology and services that improve efficiency, increase recovery and maximize production, and with over 46,000 employees representing 146 nationalities in more than 70 countries it helps customers maximize asset value throughout the lifecycle of the reservoir, from locating hydrocarbons and managing geological data.
